source: package.json contributes.commands (80 ids) vs registerCommand calls in src/extension.ts and src/commands/lcaActions.ts; partial subset checks in scripts/test-workflow-authoring.cjs, test-custom-workflow-repository.cjs, test-workflow-bpmn-diagram.cjs
title: Every declared command has a registered handler
scenario: Static test, no VS Code host. Read package.json and scan every .ts under src (excluding src/webview) for registerCommand('<id>' with optional whitespace/newline after the paren. Assert each contributes.commands id appears in at least one registerCommand call.
expected: Zero declared-but-unregistered ids. Today all 80 declared commands are registered. A new command added to package.json without a handler fails with the id named.

source: src/extension.ts registerCommand('reltio.revealInTreeView', ...) (about line 957); package.json contributes.commands
title: Registered commands are declared or on an explicit internal allowlist
scenario: Static test, same scan as ACT-001 in the other direction. Collect all registerCommand ids and assert each is in contributes.commands or in a small allowlist in the test. Current known internal-only id: reltio.revealInTreeView (registered, not declared, takes a nodeId arg).
expected: Only allowlisted ids are registered-but-undeclared. A new handler with no package.json entry (so no palette or menu path) fails unless the author adds it to the allowlist deliberately.

source: package.json contributes.menus (all groups incl. commandPalette), contributes.viewsWelcome; scripts/test-context-menu-reorganization.cjs
title: Every command referenced by menus or welcome content is declared
scenario: Static test. Walk every contributes.menus group entry with a command field and every command: link inside viewsWelcome contents. Assert each id is in contributes.commands and each is also registered (ACT-001 set).
expected: No dangling menu or welcome-link command. Currently zero menu entries reference an undeclared id. Renaming a command without updating menus fails the test.

source: package.json contributes.configuration.properties (12 reltio.* keys); getConfiguration('reltio').get(...) calls in src/extension.ts and other src files
title: Settings declared in package.json match settings read in code
scenario: Static test. Collect the 12 declared reltio.* keys and every key read via getConfiguration('reltio').get('<k>') or named constants (AGENT_SKILLS_SETTING, MATCH_VERIFICATION_SETTING) and affectsConfiguration('reltio.<k>'). Assert declared set equals read set, with a documented exception list.
expected: Every declared setting is read somewhere (all 12 currently referenced in src) and no code reads an undeclared reltio.* key, so users cannot set a key that does nothing or code cannot depend on an unregistered default.

source: package.json main, activationEvents (onLanguage:json, workspaceContains markers, onStartupFinished); ARCHITECTURE.md Application Bootstrap; scripts/test-extension-packaging.cjs, test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs (~line 746)
title: Activation events and entry point stay intact
scenario: Static test. Assert package.json main is ./dist/extension.js, activationEvents contains onStartupFinished (needed so the zero-marker onboarding path in activate() runs) and the workspaceContains entries for *.reltio.json, BusinessConfig.json, .reltio-environment.json, .reltio-config-source.json, *.reltio.environment.
expected: All seven events present and main points at the bundle. Removing onStartupFinished fails, since the setup guide auto-open would then never run in an empty workspace.

source: src/extension.ts isReltioDocument (~line 266)
title: isReltioDocument recognises only Business Config files
scenario: Private function; exercise through the stub-driven activate (ACT-010 harness) by firing the captured onDidChangeActiveTextEditor listener with documents named x.reltio.json, L3.json, l3.json, BusinessConfig.json, businessconfig.json, package.json, a.bpmn. Observe whether diagnosticsManager/uriIndex rebuild runs (spy on parseDocument path).
expected: Rebuild runs for *.reltio.json, L3.json and BusinessConfig.json (basename case-insensitive, forward-slash paths) and not for package.json or BPMN files, which take the BPMN diagnostics branch instead.

source: src/extension.ts rebuildUriIndex (~line 5142) and the four providers it feeds (linkProvider, defProvider, refProvider, uriCompletionProvider), diagnosticsManager; CLAUDE.md core invariants
title: rebuildUriIndex is the only place the UriIndex is built and pushed
scenario: Static analysis of src/extension.ts. Assert uriIndex.build( occurs exactly once, inside rebuildUriIndex; each of the four provider setIndex( calls occurs exactly once, inside rebuildUriIndex, followed by diagnosticsManager.update(doc, uriIndex). Assert no other file calls uriIndex.build.
expected: Exactly one build site and one setIndex per provider. A new navigation provider wired directly in a change listener (bypassing rebuildUriIndex) fails the test.

source: src/extension.ts onDidChangeTextDocument (debounced with DEBOUNCE_MS), onDidChangeActiveTextEditor, activate tail (activeEditor initial rebuild)
title: rebuildUriIndex callers: debounced edit, editor switch, initial active editor
scenario: Stub-driven activate with fake timers. (a) Fire onDidChangeTextDocument twice quickly for a Reltio doc: rebuild runs once after DEBOUNCE_MS. (b) Fire onDidChangeActiveTextEditor with a Reltio doc: immediate rebuild. (c) Activate with activeTextEditor set to a Reltio doc: one rebuild at startup. Non-Reltio docs: none.
expected: Rebuild counts 1, 1 and 1 respectively; tree provider onL3DocumentChanged is called per edit event; no rebuild for non-Reltio documents.

source: src/extension.ts applyTrustedHostSuffixes (~line 421) and first statements of activate; src/api trusted-host setter; scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs
title: Trusted host suffixes are applied first and re-applied on change
scenario: Stub-driven activate with a getConfiguration returning ['example.test'] for reltio.trustedHostSuffixes. Assert setTrustedHostSuffixes receives that value before any other setup runs, default is ['reltio.com'], and firing onDidChangeConfiguration with affectsConfiguration true for that key re-applies; false for other keys does not.
expected: Allowlist is set synchronously at activation start and tracks live setting changes, so no token can be attached under a stale host list.

source: src/extension.ts activate (order of statements); scripts/lib/vscode-stub.cjs (currently has no activate harness: workspace.getConfiguration returns fallback, registerCommand returns a no-op disposable)
title: Activation sequence order is stable
scenario: Static order check on src/extension.ts text, no host. Assert source index order: applyTrustedHostSuffixes() < new TokenStore() < createTreeView('reltioConfigTree') < registerCommand('reltio.resyncAgentAssets') < function rebuildUriIndex < initial activeEditor rebuild < setupTokenFileWatchers() < applyDefaultsOnActivate block (last).
expected: Order matches ARCHITECTURE.md Application Bootstrap. Moving trust setup after store creation, or auto-apply before providers exist, is flagged for deliberate review.

source: src/extension.ts context.subscriptions.push sites (createTreeView, createFileSystemWatcher x4+, register*Provider, createOutputChannel, onDid* listeners, disposeTokenFileWatchers)
title: Every disposable created during activation lands in context.subscriptions
scenario: Needs an extended vscode stub that records created watchers, listeners, providers, tree views, output channels and returns trackable disposables. Activate with a recording ExtensionContext, then dispose all context.subscriptions and assert every recorded disposable has been disposed.
expected: Zero undisposed disposables after disposing subscriptions. A new watcher or listener created but not pushed fails the test. Requires extending scripts/lib/vscode-stub.cjs (not available today).

source: src/extension.ts uxMode read (line 559), isClassic gates: StatusBarController creation (~line 739) and setup guide auto-open (~line 5285)
title: Classic UX mode skips status bar and setup guide auto-open
scenario: Stub-driven activate with workspace folder and reltio.uxMode = 'classic' vs 'default', empty tenant folder. Count StatusBarController item creation and openSetupGuidePanel (createWebviewPanel) calls.
expected: classic: no status bar item and no guide panel. default: status bar created and guide opened once for a workspace with zero environments.

source: src/extension.ts setupTokenFileWatchers / disposeTokenFileWatchers (~lines 5300-5370), onDidChangeConfiguration for reltio.defaultEnvironments
title: Token-file watchers are rebuilt cleanly and skipped when untrusted
scenario: Stub-driven activate with defaultEnvironments naming one tokenFile. (a) isTrusted false: no token-file watcher created. (b) trusted: one watcher and one startup read. (c) fire config change for reltio.defaultEnvironments: previous watcher and pending reload timers disposed before the new one is created.
expected: Untrusted workspace creates zero token-file watchers; re-setup never leaves two live watchers for the same file; no timer fires after dispose.

source: src/extension.ts activate with getWorkspaceFolder() undefined (line 262, 551); environmentManager null paths
title: Activation with no workspace folder open
scenario: Stub-driven activate with workspace.workspaceFolders = [] (the stub default). Assert activate resolves without throwing, all commands are registered, the tree view is created, and no environment scan, migration, agent sync, guide auto-open, token-file watcher or apply-defaults call happens.
expected: Resolves cleanly; environmentManager-dependent work is skipped (null guards); declared commands still resolve to handlers so palette entries do not report 'command not found'.

source: src/extension.ts workspace source selection (~lines 700-735): scanEnvironments, setWorkspaceSource('tenant'|'git'|undefined), tryRestoreGitSource
title: Workspace source is chosen as tenant, git or none
scenario: Stub-driven activate over memory-fs workspaces: (a) a tenant folder with environment marker; (b) no environments but a restorable .reltio-config-source.json; (c) neither. Capture the value passed to publishWorkspaceSourceContext / setContext.
expected: (a) 'tenant' and layout migration started off the critical path; (b) 'git'; (c) undefined. Tenant detection takes priority over git restore.

source: src/extension.ts first-run guide (~line 5285): workspaceState key reltio.setupGuideAutoOpened; openSetupGuidePanel
title: Setup Guide auto-opens once per workspace with no environments
scenario: Stub-driven activate twice on the same workspaceState in an empty folder (needs createWebviewPanel stub), then once in a folder that has an environment. Real panel rendering is manual QA (Tier C); the gating logic is stub-testable.
expected: First activation opens the guide and sets the flag; second does not; a workspace with at least one environment never opens it.

source: src/extension.ts walkthrough suppression (~line 5262): globalState key reltio.walkthroughSeen, oauthCredentialsStore.hasClientCredentials
title: Upgrade users never see the walkthrough auto-open
scenario: Stub-driven activate with globalState empty: (a) workspace has an environment; (b) no environment but OAuth client credentials exist in the fake SecretStorage; (c) neither. Read globalState reltio.walkthroughSeen afterwards.
expected: (a) and (b) set the flag true; (c) leaves it unset/false. Already-true flag is never reset.

source: src/extension.ts end of activate (~line 5715): applyDefaultsOnActivate, runApplyDefaultEnvironments(false), vscode.workspace.isTrusted
title: applyDefaultsOnActivate runs only when enabled, trusted and a folder is open
scenario: Stub-driven activate with spy on the apply-defaults path. Matrix: setting false/true x isTrusted false/true x folder present/absent. Also make the apply throw once.
expected: Runs exactly once only for (true, trusted, folder). Default is false (no auto-apply). A thrown error is caught and logged with console.error, activation still resolves.

source: src/extension.ts session restore (~line 5245): sessionStore.loadRefreshToken, resolveOAuthCredentials, refreshTokens, tokenStore.setSession, sessionStore.deleteRefreshToken
title: Saved OAuth sessions are restored or purged at activation
scenario: Stub-driven activate with fake SecretStorage holding refresh tokens for 3 environments and a stubbed refresh endpoint: A succeeds, B has no client credentials, C fails the refresh. Await the background restore.
expected: A: session set in TokenStore and rotated refresh token saved. B: refresh token deleted. C: refresh token deleted. Tree refreshed after. Activation itself does not wait on this.

source: src/extension.ts runLayoutMigration (~line 620), runAgentAssetSync/offerResync (~line 570), session restore catch (~line 5262), applyOnActivate catch
title: Background activation failures are surfaced or contained, never thrown
scenario: Stub-driven activate where, in turn: migrateWorkspace rejects; syncReltioAgentAssets rejects; scanEnvironments rejects inside session restore; runApplyDefaultEnvironments rejects. Capture showWarningMessage and console.error.
expected: Migration failure shows a warning (migrationFailureMessage); agent sync failure offers 'Resync Agent Assets'; session-restore scan failure is swallowed; apply-defaults failure is console.error. activate() resolves in every case.

source: src/extension.ts onDidChangeConfiguration for reltio.installAgentSkills (~line 868), createModeSyncTrigger, runAgentAssetSync
title: Changing installAgentSkills syncs agent assets only once a source is known
scenario: Stub-driven activate; fire onDidChangeConfiguration with affectsConfiguration('reltio.installAgentSkills') true (a) before a workspace source is chosen (workspaceSource undefined) and (b) after 'tenant'. Spy on syncReltioAgentAssets.
expected: (a) no sync; (b) one sync with force false. Unrelated config keys never trigger sync.

source: src/extension.ts onDidCloseTextDocument, bpmnDiagnosticsDebounce (KeyedDebouncer), bpmnProcessIdForDocument branch in onDidChangeTextDocument
title: Closing a document clears its diagnostics and pending BPMN update
scenario: Stub-driven activate with fake timers. Edit a BPMN document (schedules debounced update), then fire onDidCloseTextDocument for it; also close a Reltio JSON doc that had diagnostics.
expected: Pending BPMN update is cancelled (no late diagnostics on a closed file) and bpmnDiagnosticsManager.clear called; Reltio doc close calls diagnosticsManager.clear(uri).

source: package.json activationEvents, contributes.commands, views; src/extension.ts activate; ARCHITECTURE.md Application Bootstrap
title: Fresh install activates in a real window (manual QA)
scenario: Manual (Tier C), needs a real VS Code or Cursor host. Install the VSIX, open (a) an empty folder, (b) a folder with a *.reltio.json, (c) no folder. Check Extension Host log, Reltio tree view, Command Palette entries for reltio.* commands.
expected: Extension activates in all three with no errors in the Extension Host log, tree view appears, setup guide opens once in (a), every palette command runs its handler or a clear prompt.

source: src/extension.ts session restore, setupTokenFileWatchers (isTrusted gate), applyDefaultsOnActivate gate
title: Reload and Restricted Mode behaviour (manual QA)
scenario: Manual (Tier C). Sign in with browser OAuth, reload the window. Then open the same workspace in Restricted Mode with defaultEnvironments and a tokenFile configured and applyDefaultsOnActivate true.
expected: After reload the environment shows signed in without prompting. In Restricted Mode no token file is read, no defaults are applied and no network call is made on startup.

source: src/extension.ts deactivate() (empty), bpmnDiagnosticsDebounce, repoRediscovery, tokenFileReloadTimers, overrideTimer, debounceTimer (onDidChangeTextDocument)
title: Disposing subscriptions leaves no pending timers
scenario: Stub-driven activate with fake timers: schedule a BPMN diagnostics update, a repo rediscovery, a token-file reload, an overrides resync and a Reltio doc edit; dispose context.subscriptions; advance timers.
expected: No handler runs after dispose for the KeyedDebouncer, token reload and override timers (all registered). NOTE: the plain debounceTimer for rebuildUriIndex is not in subscriptions today, so expect it to fire; decide whether to fix or document before implementing.

source: package.json contributes.configuration reltio.trustedHostSuffixes (scope application); scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs
title: trustedHostSuffixes cannot be set from workspace settings
scenario: Static check of package.json: property exists, scope is 'application', default contains reltio.com. Already asserted by scripts/test-harden-reltio-client-base-url.cjs (item 9); keep as the reference row when moving to the consolidated activation script.
expected: Scope stays application so a cloned repository cannot widen the allowlist and receive bearer tokens.

source: src/extension.ts globalState/workspaceState .update calls during activate; SessionStore, OAuthCredentialsStore; CLAUDE.md token invariant
title: Activation persists no tokens outside SecretStorage
scenario: Stub-driven activate through ACT-019 scenario with recording globalState, workspaceState and settings update. Also static check: workspaceState/globalState .update keys in extension.ts activation path are limited to a known list (walkthroughSeen, setupGuideAutoOpened, openedL3Files, enclosingRepoWarningDismissed, layout migration keys).
expected: No access or refresh token string appears in globalState, workspaceState or configuration writes; refresh tokens only go through SessionStore (SecretStorage). New state keys require updating the allowlist.

source: src/extension.ts activate: void runLayoutMigration(...), void refreshUxState(), void (async restore), void runApplyDefaultEnvironments; ARCHITECTURE.md Application Bootstrap
title: Slow work stays off the activation critical path
scenario: Stub-driven activate where migration, session restore, refreshUxState and apply-defaults return never-resolving promises. Race activate() against a short timeout.
expected: activate() resolves while those promises are still pending (they are void-launched). Only the environment scans for walkthrough/guide gating are awaited inline.

source: src/extension.ts isReltioDocument (split on forward slash only, ~line 268), workflow repo watcher samePath (win32 lowercase compare, ~line 5048)
title: Windows path handling in document matching
scenario: Call the stub-driven isReltioDocument check (ACT-006 harness) with fileName 'C:\ws\env\tenant\L3.json' and 'C:\ws\x.reltio.json'. Separately assert the repo watcher compares paths case-insensitively when process.platform is win32.
expected: Characterize current behavior: .reltio.json matches with backslashes. L3.json / BusinessConfig.json by basename use split(/[\/]/) which only splits on forward slash, so backslash paths may not match. Confirm intent with the owner before pinning.
